name: Facetdolly
description: Open with the haft held in two matched halves of the stance so each hand guards its own side.

name: Granite Sledgeface
description: Bring the head over in a heavy arc and follow it at once with a second shorter stroke.

name: Immobilizing Gripbulge
description: Shove with both ends of the haft in turn to rock the opponent from one foot to the other.

name: Silt Pulverize
description: Glide across the floor on the balls of the feet with the head carried low and level.

name: Sanguine Squash
description: Alternate the head and the haft end in matched strikes while qi cycles through both arms.

name: Dollynerve
description: Cross the haft against a descending cut and slide it off to the right of the body.

name: Chime Sledge
description: Tap the head between two linked enemy weapons and burst qi to spring them apart.

name: Ironquake
description: Drop the head twice on the same line so the second fall lands on what the first has cracked.

name: Heavyhelve Havoc
description: Strike through the stone pillar behind the enemy so that fragments burst out into the target.

name: Tempered Mallethead
description: Bring both strokes down as one with the full qi of a Monarch behind them and stagger everything nearby.

name: Endcap Nerve
description: Hold the maul above the head so its shadow falls across the guard and its haft covers the crown.

name: Iron Flatten
description: Fall onto the target from the rim of a stance as a stone falls into a basin.

name: Squashvortex
description: Pivot on one foot with the head high and wheel to face the opponent's open side.

name: Thudruin
description: Rain blows down one after the other until the space around the target is filled with force.

name: Mayhem Thud
description: Hook the haft over the wrist like a claw and wrench the weapon arm downward.

name: Unconquered Pommelweight
description: Throw both arms wide so the haft sweeps a thrust up and away like a beating wing.

name: Might Maulhead
description: Leap higher than the opponent expects and bring the head down on the skull from above.

name: Silt Quake
description: Slam the head into the floor so the ground sinks like a bowl and the nearby are pitched together.

name: Blaze Sledge
description: Spring up like a hawk and come down into the basin with the whole field of qi behind the head.

name: Dollyvalor
description: Plant the feet as if on a river bed and hold the haft low and flat against the current of cuts.

name: Brutalizing Sledgeface
description: Pound the head down hard and fast like rapids striking a stone and bring it straight back up.

name: Overbearing Pommelweight
description: Knock the haft ends against the opponent's elbows in a matched pair to numb the arms.

name: Granite Pulverize
description: Hop from one shallow footing to the next with the maul carried high on the shoulders.

name: Granite Wedgeface
description: Sweep the head low across the mouth of a narrow passage to hit every shin that enters it.

name: Squashscourge
description: Pour out a torrent of strokes with qi streaming from the back to the wrists without a pause.

name: Adamantine Ironband
description: Spin the haft in a tight circle that draws a thrust round and flings it off.

name: Nova Gripbulge
description: Drive the narrow face into the join of two shields like a wedge into a failing dam.

name: Squash Wrath
description: Come down between two foes so the head splits them apart as a stone splits a stream.

name: Mayhem Mallethead
description: Slam the head down so the force rolls outward in a flood across the ground and sweeps feet away.

name: Might Wedgeface
description: Bring down two matched strokes charged with a qi field so a whole file of enemies is broken.

name: Aegisendcap
description: Raise the haft before the face with arms extended to take the first cut at a distance.

name: Tempered Maulhead
description: Let the maul fall from the top of its arc and open the exchange with its dead weight.

name: Blinding Flatten
description: Turn on the lead foot in a precise half circle so the body and head change sides together.

name: Endcapdurance
description: Ram the haft into one shoulder and then the other to spin the opponent off balance.

name: Sanguine Quake
description: Sweep the head along the ground and strike the greaves hard enough to dent the metal.

name: Gnashing Thud
description: Let blows fall one after another in a measured chain while qi holds steady in both arms.

name: Murkmallet
description: Turn the whole body behind the haft so that a cut spends itself against the wood and slides away.

name: Vengeful Maulbutt
description: Hammer one knee and then the other in two quick low blows to bring the opponent down.

name: Enthralling Heavyhelve
description: Press the haft across the throat line and lean with qi until the opponent is forced backward.

name: Endcap Havoc
description: Drop the head and without lifting it fully drop it again to finish what the first fall began.

name: Squashhavoc
description: Strike the court floor so that the flagstones lift and rock together and unseat those who stand on them.

name: Mangling Squash
description: Let the whole falling maul descend with a qi field shaped around the head until the ground itself gives way.

name: Endcap Tenacity
description: Spread the arms like wings with the haft across them so a cut meets wood before flesh.

name: Blazemallet
description: Drop the head as heavily as a stone into a basin so the blow rings through the target.

name: Headlong Quake
description: Skip off both heels one after another to slide out of line of a sweeping cut.

name: Nova Sledge
description: Whip the end of the haft out like a wing tip and jab it into the ribs.

name: Granite Ironband
description: Follow a heavy stone-like drop with a long sweeping wing stroke and repeat with qi held low.

name: Chime Ironband
description: Tilt the haft along the curve of a basin rim so that a cut rolls off it.

name: Squashdurance
description: Smash the head twice against a blade in succession until the grip fails and the weapon drops.

name: Rumble Pulverize
description: Wheel the maul outward and bring it down in a broad curve that no single guard can cover.

name: Dismantling Wedgeface
description: Drive the head into the ground so that a shock rolls out like a ripple from a dropped stone.

name: Gust Flatten
description: Unite the weight of the stone and the reach of the wing in a single blow that sunders guard and stance together.

name: Maulbutt Nerve
description: Hold the maul at the ready with its head rumbling low beside the knee and the haft in front.

name: Lacerating Maulhead
description: Fall along one track of the stance and shift the weight to the second track as the head lands.

name: Hellish Thud
description: Roll the head round in a low heavy sweep that rumbles along the ground like distant thunder.

name: Quakeglare
description: Place each foot exactly on its own track so the heavy body moves without wasted effort.

name: Chimebeetle
description: Shove with the haft held like two poles in the hands and drive the opponent back a full stride.

name: Sanguine Sledgeface
description: Chain strokes so quickly that each lands with a clap and the claps run together with qi in both arms.

name: Torrent Gripbulge
description: Parry on one track with the haft and slip the body along the second track behind it.

name: Thudscourge
description: Beat the head against a guard and let the echo of qi follow the first blow a heartbeat later.

name: Lightning Maulbutt
description: Stamp in with a sound like thunder and cross the gap before the opponent can reset.

name: Might Pommelweight
description: Drop the maul on one track and release a second charge of qi along the other track.

name: Mayhem Maulbutt
description: Break the ground along two lines at once so the cracks cross beneath the enemy ranks.

name: Corroding Heavyhelve
description: Gather qi over the head for several breaths like a storm cloud then bring it down in one great stroke.

name: Gust Ironband
description: Strike on both tracks as one so two thunders of qi break upon the target in the same instant.

name: Iron Sledgeface
description: Hold the haft level on the oath bearing and let every cut break upon it.

name: Gust Gripbulge
description: Raise the head and drop it on the same sworn line without any deviation.

name: Torrent Flatten
description: Tread forward with each foot set flat and firm as upon the bare plateau.

name: Gust Thud
description: Hammer along one bearing in an unbroken chain with qi held steady at the shoulders.

name: Sledgenerve
description: Press the haft against the chest and burst qi to push the opponent off the sworn line.

name: Torrent Mallethead
description: Turn the haft with the wind so a strike is carried past as a leaf is carried.

name: Decimating Squash
description: Add the weight of the sworn oath and a charge of qi to the fall of the head.

name: Siltendcap
description: Strike the ground on the sworn line so the shock travels outward and unseats the nearby.

name: Eviscerating Pulverize
description: Hold the bearing to the last breath then let the whole Monarch reserve fall through the head.

name: Endcap Fortitude
description: Stand with the feet wide and the head grounded so no gust or shove can move the body.

name: Ironmallet
description: Time the fall of the head to the last step before a drop and let gravity add its weight.

name: Dazzling Sledge
description: Lower the shoulder into the wind and rush forward with the maul trailing at the hip.

name: Overpowering Quake
description: Rap the haft against a sword hand as one raps a wedge into a rock seam.

name: Mallethead Ruin
description: Hammer in a rising rhythm that matches each blow to a gust and holds qi steady in the arms.

name: Equipoise Heavyhelve
description: Swing the broad head into the path of a thrust so wind and qi together turn it aside.

name: Harnessing Pommelweight
description: Knock a raised weapon crosswise as the gust hits and send it spinning from the hand.

name: Granite Maulbutt
description: Bring the head down through guard and stone alike with the gale pressing at the back.

name: Slag Maulhead
description: Hammer the ground near an edge so the whole lip shudders and the nearby stagger.

name: Ruinous Quake
description: Let the gale and a field of qi drive the maul down until stone and stance both fail.

name: Iron Wedgeface
description: Take the bearing with the haft pointed along it and hold it like a rail against cuts.

name: Gustsledge
description: Bring the head over and down along the bearing that was taken at the start.

name: Hollowsledge
description: Thrust the haft end along a line as narrow as a needle into one gap in the armor.

name: Pommelweight Glimmer
description: Walk the bearing in unhurried steps with the head riding steady at the hip.

name: Healing Heavyhelve
description: Tap the poll lightly in the air and feel which way the wind will push the next blow.

name: Blaze Pulverize
description: Strike again and again along the held line while qi flows level through both arms.

name: Beetlespine
description: Cross the haft over the bearing line so a thrust is turned and the line stays clear.

name: Mayhemmallet
description: Catch an enemy weapon on the haft and wrench it off its line with a burst of qi.

name: Rumblebeetle
description: Hold the bearing through the whole lift and drop the head on its exact end.

name: Siltbeetle
description: Slam the head down so the shock runs out in one straight line along the bearing.

name: Tempered Wedgeface
description: Keep the maul on its bearing through every guard and spend a whole qi field on the last fall.

name: Facetmallet
description: Hold the haft crosswise at chest height in the open and take cuts from every side upon it.

name: Tempered Endcap
description: Hold the oath in mind and bring the head over in a stroke that does not waver.

name: Iron Ironband
description: Sweep the head low like a stone rolled along the ground to take both ankles.

name: Ghosting Mallethead
description: Shuffle along the very edge of firm ground with the maul held low on the outer side.

name: Rumble Maulhead
description: Rap the haft against the weapon hand in time with a gust so the grip loosens.

name: Irondolly
description: String strokes along the open edge of ground with qi steady in the arms between each fall.

name: Murk Gripbulge
description: Open the stance wide and sweep the haft across so a thrust is turned into the empty air.

name: Might Sledgeface
description: Take a step with the wind at the back and drop the head on the attacker as he recovers.

name: Mastering Squash
description: Pin a weapon to the ground under the head and stand on the haft until it is let go.

name: Quakewrath
description: Come down on the target across open ground with the sworn weight of the whole body.

name: Brutalizing Wedgeface
description: Shatter the hard ground under the head so that sworn stone and sprung earth fly outward.

name: Berserk Endcap Scourge
description: Spend the whole qi field on one fall that no guard on the open plateau can break.

name: Iron Maulbutt
description: Cover the body with the haft while the sworn head hangs ready at the side.

name: Dollyhavoc
description: Open the rite with a single measured fall of the head onto the target.

name: Meteoric Sledge
description: Step through the rite's pattern of turns so that the body is never where a cut expects it.

name: Iron Thud
description: Complete the rite's cycle in a chain of falls with qi unbroken from the first to the last.

name: Hogtying Pulverize
description: Hold a weapon tight against the head and wrench with the gale's push until it leaves the hand.

name: Torrent Sledgeface
description: Swing the sworn head up into a thrust and send it wide of the body.

name: Sanguine Maulhead
description: Bring the head down at the rite's appointed beat with the gale's whole weight behind it.

name: Thudwrath
description: Pound the ground at the rite's close so that the shock ripples out like wind over grass.

name: Merciless Blaze Mallethead
description: Close the rite with one fall in which the sworn head carries the full qi field into the target.

name: Aegis Gripbulge
description: Stand in the open with the haft angled in front so the guard is the only shelter.

name: Rumblemallet
description: Swing the head up and over with the whole stance planted flat on open ground.

name: Silt Flatten
description: Step out from any cover at an angle so the next blow comes from an unexpected side.

name: Ruinous Squash
description: Jab the haft end in short darting thrusts while circling the target at a steady pace.

name: Quakehavoc
description: Rush across open ground dropping the head at every few strides while qi stays level.

name: Pommelweight Hardihood
description: Let a thrust pass through the open stance and sweep the haft over it to strand the attacker.

name: Maiming Sledge
description: Heave the haft against the chest and burst qi to send the opponent staggering into open space.

name: Iron Heavyhelve
description: Drop the maul with no cover or retreat planned so that every ounce of the bearer lands on the blow.

name: Daybreak Ironband
description: Break the open ground with one stroke so that sod and rock heave up around the target.

name: Hellish Rumble Wedgeface
description: Bring down the maul on open ground with a qi field drawn from the whole sky above the bearer.
